description:
Search the public LinkedIn Ad Library (B2B ads of the last 12 months) by keyword and/or
        advertiser name.

        Cost: 1 credit per call, whatever the number of ads returned (an empty result too);
        an error costs 0. The next page is a new call (1 credit).

        Args:
            query: Keyword or phrase in the ad. query or advertiser is required.
            advertiser: Advertiser (company) name, e.g. 'HubSpot'.
            country: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country where the ads were shown, or 'ALL' (default).
            date_range: 'all' (default), 'last_30_days', 'current_month', 'current_year' or
                'last_year'. Or use active_from/active_to instead.
            active_from: YYYY-MM-DD, within the last 12 months.
            active_to: YYYY-MM-DD.
            sort: 'newest' (default) or 'oldest'.
            limit: Ads per page, 1-25 (default 10).
            cursor: next_cursor from a previous call, to get the next page (same filters).
name: search_linkedin_ads
title: Search LinkedIn ads
